project.name: Annual CO₂ emissions — Our World in Data

why: A single first-party indicator presents the same country-by-year data as a comparison line chart, choropleth map, ranked bars, and table. It is a concise reference for selecting a view based on the user's question while keeping the underlying data and controls consistent.
dataShape: Country and region annual-emissions time series, with selectable entities and a selected-year ranking.

hierarchy.evidence: The chart covers annual observations from 1750 through 2024 and lets the reader select a year or time range.
Countries and regions can be searched, added, removed, compared, and ranked.

encodings.mapping: Year is the horizontal axis, annual emissions in tonnes are the vertical axis, and color distinguishes selected entities.
Geography identifies the entity and sequential color communicates emissions magnitude for the selected year.
Entities are ranked for the selected year with numeric values available in the table.

interactions.evidence: The official chart offers chart, map, table, and bar presentations for the same indicator.
Readers can search for and add or remove countries and regions from a comparison set.
The chart provides downloadable data and metadata alongside the interactive views.

accessibility.evidence: The official table view and downloadable CSV and metadata provide data alternatives to the graphical views.
When adapting this pattern, label view tabs and controls semantically and retain the table alternative rather than relying on color alone.

capture.attribution: Our World in Data; data attribution on the chart is Global Carbon Budget (2025), with major processing by Our World in Data.
capture.reusePolicy: inspiration-only — distill the observed multi-view, comparison, and data-access patterns without copying chart artwork. OWID-produced material is CC BY with attribution requirements; underlying third-party data remains subject to its provider terms.
